rachel-dx: quick note from today's sampleapp onboarding run: schema enforcement (strict JSON mode) disappears after an auth retry. first attempt rejects extra props, retry accepts them.

noah-sdk: that sounds like the retry path is recreating helpers without the original opts. minimal repro?

rachel-dx: yep. gist below: create client with jsonMode:true & strictSchema:true, simulate 401 -> retry wrapper calls factory again which reads env-defaults. snippet:```js
const client = new RedwoodSDK({ jsonMode: true, strictSchema: true, helperFactory: makeHelper });
await client.callTool('getAccount', payload); // on 401 retry: helper = makeHelper() // factory defaults to process.env.DEFAULT_STRICT=false
```

anya-qa: we saw a customer hit this; downstream fncall parsing failed because the final output shape widened. I can reproduce by toggling DEFAULT_STRICT in CI and forcing an auth 401 on first try.

noah-sdk: quick fix: have RetryClient capture the original helper options (shallow clone) and reuse them for retries. I'll add unit tests for RetryClient and a small integration e2e that simulates a 401 and asserts the final tool output still fails validation for invalid extra fields.

rachel-dx: can we also add a lightweight ESLint rule in samplekit that warns when helperFactory reads process.env for strict/json defaults? would catch this anti-pattern early.

anya-qa: I'll add an invariant e2e to the sampleapp CI: run onboarding with a forced 401 and assert schema behavior is identical regardless of DEFAULT_STRICT env. also add a TS compile-time guard for samplekit consumers.

noah-sdk: plan: PR will include a) RetryClient patch to thread opts (strictSchema, jsonMode, schema) b) unit tests c) samplekit e2e + tsd check d) docs blurb under SDK helpers about "preserve helper options across retries" e) optional eslint rule. tagging @anya-qa for test signoff.

auth-bot: auth-service: transient 401 spike recorded 2026-08-14T15:42Z — clients may see a single automatic retry.

rachel-dx: thanks. Please add a short dev note in samplekit README showing a safe factory pattern: `function makeHelper(opts = {}) { return new Helper({ jsonMode: true, strictSchema: true, ...opts }); }` so teams know to pass preserved opts into factory on retry.

noah-sdk: will do. aiming to land patch + tests + docs today and canary on dedicated tomorrow AM. :thumbsup:
